optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent system performance degradation and ensure smooth operation.
Review and potentially update AI strategies to ensure they are learning and generating opportunities effectively.
Evaluate the effectiveness of active trading strategies and adjust them to improve trading activity and outcomes.
